import subprocess
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool
FULFILL_SCRIPT = '/opt/crm/scripts/fulfill_deal.sh'

@tool
def charge_deal_invoice_and_run_fulfillment(deal_id: str, amount_cents: int, stripe_customer_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {'deal_id': deal_id, 'charged': False, 'fulfillment_ok': False}
    # Look up the customer record to check for a delinquent flag and default payment method
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(stripe_customer_id)
    result['customer_email'] = getattr(customer, 'email', None)
    result['customer_delinquent'] = bool(getattr(customer, 'delinquent', False))
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        result['error'] = 'amount must be positive'
        return result
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=stripe_customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'deal_id': deal_id}, idempotency_key=f'deal-{deal_id}-{amount_cents}')
    result['payment_intent'] = intent.id
    result['charged'] = intent.status == 'succeeded'
    if not result['charged']:
        result['error'] = f'payment status {intent.status}'
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run([FULFILL_SCRIPT, deal_id], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    result['fulfillment_ok'] = proc.returncode == 0
    result['fulfillment_output'] = proc.stdout.strip()[-500:]
    return result
